name: dev.bmcreations.scrcast.internal.recorder.receiver.RecordingNotificationReceiver
description: Scrcast, Brandon McAnsh's screen recording library, uses this Receiver when you tap pause, resume, or stop on a recording notification. It sends your choice to the active recording.
disableEffect: Disabling it can make the recording notification controls unavailable, so you may not be able to pause, resume, or stop a recording there.
